uncited: **Device Check**: Check the device's local memory size.
- Create the projection buffer and set kernel arguments.
The kernel iterates over X and Y coordinates.
For each voxel $(x, y, z)$, it calculates the projection coordinates $(u, v)$ on the detector.
It uses local memory to cache two columns of the projection image (`col0` and `col1`) to facilitate bilinear interpolation of the projection value at $(u, v)$.
- **Local Memory Overflow**: If $2 \times H \times \text{sizeof(float)}$ exceeds the device's local memory limit, the behavior is undefined or the kernel may fail.
Large numbers of projections may lead to precision loss.
- **Time Complexity**: $O(P \cdot NX \cdot NX \cdot NY)$, same as CPU backprojection, but optimized for GPU parallelism.
